name: HoLT
frozen: The score, the candidate path and the <30% sequence-identity guard are fit and calibrated on training chains alone; test labels are read once, after the rule is frozen, to report counts and copy events
purpose: risk-controlled hard subset of an existing benchmark's test set: chains that a fixed homology adversary cannot answer by copying training labels

inputs.training_chains: chains with labels; sequences, structures, PDB entry of each chain
inputs.held_out_chains: the benchmark's validation and test chains, scored only after the rule is frozen
inputs.hit_tables: for each route, the training self-search: MMseqs2 (identity, bits; up to 300 hits), Foldseek (bits; up to 300 hits), ESM-2 650M and ESM C 600M last-layer mean cosine (500 nearest)
inputs.clusters: MMseqs2 easy-cluster of the training sequences at --min-seq-id 0.3 -c 0.8 --cov-mode 0

unit: family: a connected component of the graph that links training chains of one PDB entry and chains of one 30% cluster

roles.design: representatives (primary): per tier and label set, at most one eligible chain per family, no representative among another representative's top-5 annotated hits on any of the four routes (the chains whose labels its features and copying event read); grown greedily from hit lists alone, fewest conflicts first, ties by sha256('rep:' + chain id)
roles.representatives_library: the whole training set outside the representative's own family (mmseqs30) or PDB entry (pdb), as test chains retrieve the training set
roles.design_chains: every eligible non-representative chain, retrieving the training set without the representatives of that label set (and outside its own family or entry)
roles.split_variant: 40% of families by sha256 of the family name calibrate with one representative each (smallest sha256('rep:' + chain id)) and retrieve only the other 60%, which is also the design set

tiers.mmseqs30: family held out: a representative retrieves training chains outside its own family
tiers.pdb: entry held out: a representative retrieves training chains outside its own PDB entry; its family stays in the library

adversary.homology: per route MMseqs2 and Foldseek: labels of the top-scoring annotated hit and the strict-majority vote of the five top-scoring annotated hits; on held-out chains also every same-PDB training chain
adversary.four: the same with the ESM-2 and ESM C neighbours added

events.ec_exact: a copied label set contains a complete level-4 EC number of the chain; only chains with such a number are scored
events.go_raw: a copied GO term set reaches F1 >= 0.5 against the chain's terms

score.model: logistic regression (C = 1, standardised features) fitted on design chains

path.set: chains whose score is below the quantile and whose maximum MMseqs2 identity at any coverage is below 30%; held-out chains with a training sibling or an identical training sequence never enter

test.statistic: number of calibration representatives in the candidate that the adversary answers; exact binomial lower tail at alpha
test.primary: guard design, calibration and deployment at maximum MMseqs2 identity below 30% at any coverage; fit on guarded design; fixed sequence starts at the first candidate whose size admits a zero-event pass at alpha = 0.05; each candidate uses delta / (K x 4), stopping at the first failure; CLI default K = 1; JSON key 'pooled'

variants.bonferroni: every candidate at delta / (K x 4 x 12), the largest passing one
variants.mondrian: design tertiles of the label-free vote size; fixed sequence within each stratum at delta / (K x 4 x strata)
variants.cluster: split design, mmseqs30 only: every eligible chain of a calibration family, a family counts once if any of its chains in the candidate is answered; fixed sequence at delta / (K x 4)

screens.similarity: one common design quantile on the four best similarities (ablation)
